our_interpretation: The plain reading is that courts were still reporting legal submissions containing LLM-fabricated citations.

The target period is May 1–24, 2025, reflecting the post’s explicit reference to examples from this month. The relevant events are public judicial findings during that period; the underlying submissions may be earlier.
This claim does not specify a hallucination rate or assert that every legal AI tool produces fabricated citations.
criteria.support_condition: A court record published during May 1–24, 2025 establishes that AI-generated fictitious legal authorities had reached legal proceedings.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable evidence establishes that the purported contemporary examples were not AI-generated fabricated legal citations and that the problem had ceased. An absence of discovered examples alone would not establish this.
